subject: Compact demo repack for Citrine Health - exec window constraint
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Joanne Liu <joanne.liu@citrinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compact demo repack for Citrine Health - exec window constraint

Hi Joanne / Amit —

Thanks again for coordinating time. We’re set to run the demo on Thursday, 6/30 at 10:00–11:00 PT. Per our discovery, we planned a full walkthrough (~60 minutes) covering:
- integration & data flow
- access controls & audit logging
- latency / cost tradeoffs for batch workflows
- Q&A / next steps

Quick note — I just heard from your team that the exec sponsor may only be available for a 30-minute window. If that’s the case, we can compress the runbook to a 30-minute exec-focused session and follow up asynchronously with a short recorded deep dive on integration details.

Karthik / Soojin — if we compress to 30 minutes, can you confirm which two sections you’d prioritize and whether we should switch any content to a follow-up recording or shared doc? I can propose a pared-down agenda once I hear back.

Attachments: demo-deck-v3.pdf (current deck)

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Joanne Liu <joanne.liu@citrinehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@citrinehealth.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: 2026-06-26T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact demo repack for Citrine Health - exec window constraint

Thanks Lauren — quick update from our side: the exec (our VP of Product) has a hard 30-minute window between 10:15–10:45 PT on Thursday. Our technical lead (Amit) will be on for the full hour, but the exec will only join for that slice.

For the 30 minutes, the exec wants to see:
1) how Redwood would fit into our existing data ingestion + PHI-handling pipeline (high level)
2) your reliability SLA and audit/log access story (short)

If you can focus the live session on those two bullets and leave integration specifics for a follow-up, that would be ideal. We’d appreciate a short recording and a 1-page integration checklist we can share with our engineering org after the call.

Also — a heads up: one of our stakeholders will be remote on cellular and may have intermittent audio.

Joanne
Director, Solutions — Citrine Health
joanne.liu@citrinehealth.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Joanne Liu <joanne.liu@citrinehealth.com>, Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@citrinehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact demo repack for Citrine Health - exec window constraint

Karthik / Soojin —

Thanks Joanne for the clarity. Karthik, can you lead the live 30-minute slot and prioritize: 10:15–10:25 = integration overview (high level architecture + PHI considerations), 10:25–10:35 = SLA/observability + audit logs + quick Q/A. That puts the exec's time first.

Soojin, I’ll handle the commercial + next-steps minutes and call out the follow-up items.

For the follow-up: Karthik — can you prep a 10–12 minute recorded walkthrough of the integration steps (we can host in Drive) and a 1-page checklist/integration map? If you can drop the recording link and the checklist before EOD Wednesday, I’ll send it to the customer so their engineering org can review ahead of the session.

We’ll also record the live session and share.

Proposed short agenda to send to the customer: 
- 10:15–10:25 PT: Integration + PHI handling (Karthik)
- 10:25–10:35 PT: Reliability, audit logs, and observability (Karthik)
- 10:35–10:40 PT: Commercial next steps & logistics (Lauren)

If that works, I’ll update the calendar invite and adjust the meeting to 10:15–10:45 PT so the exec joins the start.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Lauren

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Joanne Liu <joanne.liu@citrinehealth.com>, Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@citrinehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact demo repack for Citrine Health - exec window constraint

Lauren / team —

All good from my side. I can compress and lead the 10:15–10:35 portion with the priorities you outlined. Confirming deliverables:
- I’ll produce a 12-minute recorded integration walkthrough (link will be in Drive) by 2026-06-30 18:00 PT.
- I attached an integration checklist (integration-quickstart.md) and the pared-down demo deck (demo-deck-v3.pdf) for your review.
- During the live session I’ll focus on architecture, PHI controls, and a brief note on KV/cache behavior for performance-sensitive flows.

Notes: given the remote attendee on cellular, I’ll plan to screen-share demos and keep the Q/A oriented to chat + follow-up so we don’t get interrupted by audio drops.

Lauren — please go ahead and update the invite to 10:15–10:45 PT and flag that the exec will join only the first 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: demo-deck-v3.pdf, integration-quickstart.md
